다양한 음식을 포함하고 있는 식단은 우리의 몸을 건강하게 만들어 준다.
자연은 항상 우리에게 어떤 음식이 어떤 신체에 좋은지 끊임없이 알려준다.
토마토와 우리의 심장은 닮았을 뿐만 아니라 토마토가 심장에 좋은 역할을 한다.
questions.question:
[지문]
We all know that ㉠a diet contained a variety of foods keeps our bodies healthy. But sometimes we are not sure which foods are good for which body parts. Nature, however, gives us a big clue. Look at the following examples. ㉡Each of these foods not only look like a certain body part but are also good for that body part.

㉢Slice open a tomato and compare it with the human heart. You will see that they look similar. They both have multiple hollow spaces and are red. ㉣Researchers say that the chemicals what make tomatoes red are good for your heart and blood. ㉤In addition, eating tomatoes can lower your risk of heart disease.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 글에서 자연이 우리에게 큰 힌트(clue)를 준다고는 했지만, '항상' 혹은 '끊임없이' 알려준다는 내용은 언급되지 않았다.

questions.question:
[지문]
We all know that ㉠a diet contained a variety of foods keeps our bodies healthy. But sometimes we are not sure which foods are good for which body parts. Nature, however, gives us a big clue. Look at the following examples. ㉡Each of these foods not only look like a certain body part but are also good for that body part.

㉢Slice open a tomato and compare it with the human heart. You will see that they look similar. They both have multiple hollow spaces and are red. ㉣Researchers say that the chemicals what make tomatoes red are good for your heart and blood. ㉤In addition, eating tomatoes can lower your risk of heart disease.

윗글 ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 옳은 문장 두 개를 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ㉠ 'contained'는 'containing'으로 고쳐야 한다(현재분사로 명사 수식). ㉡ 'Each of these foods'는 단수 주어이므로 'look'은 'looks'로, 'are'는 'is'로 고쳐야 한다. ㉢ 'compare A with B(A와 B를 비교하다)'는 올바른 표현이다. ㉣ 'what'은 관계대명사 'that'으로 고쳐야 한다. ㉤ 'eating tomatoes can lower your risk of heart disease'는 어법상 옳은 문장이다.

options: ⓓ prevent A from ~ing : A가 ~하는 것을 반영하다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Now, let's ⓐmove on to ginger. What body part ⓑcomes to mind when you see it? (A) You may not like ginger's strong taste or smell. (B) But these ⓒcome from a special chemical that ⓓprevents you from feeling sick and throwing up. (C) For this reason, ginger can ⓔbe good for your stomach. (D) Try to eat ginger if you often feel pain in your stomach. (E)

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 대한 해석으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'prevent A from ~ing'는 'A가 ~하는 것을 막다'라는 뜻이므로, '반영하다'로 해석한 것은 적절하지 않다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Now, let's move on to ginger. What body part comes to mind when you see it? (A) You may not like ginger's strong taste or smell. (B) But these come from a special chemical that prevents you from feeling sick and throwing up. (C) For this reason, ginger can be good for your stomach. (D) Try to eat ginger if you often feel pain in your stomach. (E)

글의 흐름을 고려할 때, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 가장 적절한 위치는?

주어진 문장: Doesn't it look like a stomach?
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장 'Doesn't it look like a stomach?(그것은 위장처럼 생기지 않았나요?)'은 생강을 보면 어떤 신체 부위가 떠오르냐는 질문 바로 다음인 (A) 위치에 들어가야 자연스럽게 이어진다.
